root_idea.summary: The root centers on making something manifest, causing it to become known, and its spreading or becoming widespread.
root_idea.development: The semantic range develops from appearance and disclosure to public dissemination; a related classical extension applies the idea of complete dispersal to consuming all the contents of a watering-trough.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form IV perfect citation form أَذَاعَ.

senses.definition: To spread, publish, reveal, disclose, or make known information, news, discourse, or a secret; to proclaim it among people.
senses.usage_conditions: A transitive Form IV use, including the construction أَذَاعَ بِهِ, meaning to disseminate or make something public.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become spread, published, divulged, revealed, or generally known; to become widespread.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of information, news, discourse, or things; also of injustice spreading and of mange or scab becoming general in the skin.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To consume completely the contents of a watering-trough or tank by drinking them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A classical tropical construction used of drinking all that is in the trough or tank.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take away another person’s property, or to take away anything.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A classical tropical use with بِهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who does not keep or conceal a secret, or who is unable to conceal information, news, or tidings; a secret-babbler.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive epithet; its plural is مَذَايِيعُ.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Form I intransitive spreading or becoming known.
Tropical application of becoming general or widespread.
Form IV transitive disclosure and proclamation, explicitly connected with a Quranic construction.
Tropical construction for drinking all the contents of a trough.
Tropical construction for taking away property or anything.
Orthographic and grammatical identification of the medial radical.
Derived noun for a person who divulges secrets.
